# Separate independent paper review: prime-support Selmer formula

Reviewer EM-PUBLIC-7CDA51, same actual Researcher SID MCP-9030ae3a22074e3dbc31679b7090f6b0 and RA-6665DBCD10BC1C3E4DED3C04. Root explicitly added this third object to the bounded nonauthor paper-review scope. It is not silently included in either preceding report. All prior history and NONBLIND context remain; there is no Native Driver vote, formal Task extension, scientific program, enumeration or claim.

Reviewed input: EM-DVR-F73673's P11_PRIME_SUPPORT_SELMER_DIMENSION_COROLLARY.md, 3810 bytes, SHA256 ba35da923a157d2d0c7dfbc5461503d79f759380ac3b3647429cde79e0e182d4, Git blob 4860e99279ac8b5e795264c63f6ba5fdfae31bdf. It is a frozen local addendum awaiting Source publication. The first two author inputs and their separate review scopes remain unchanged.

Assessment: dependent PAPER PASS for the exact added prime-support hypotheses and its conditional pairing consequences. Its essential new parameter-local dependency has been separately checked in P11_PARAMETRIC_LOCAL_IMAGE_INDEPENDENT_PAPER_REVIEW.md; this verdict does not invoke a prior fixed-core PASS as a substitute for that dependency.

For coprime distinct positive odd P,Q, the odd prime supports of P,Q,D=P²-Q² are disjoint. Assume 32|D and that every prime dividing PQ is 3 modulo 4. Start with the complete split-descent signed support coordinates on 2PQD. The real place removes the first-coordinate sign bit. The dyadic vertical image removes its 2 bit. At each odd p dividing D the vertical image removes its p bit. At each prime dividing PQ the unramified-pair image removes both valuation bits at that prime. This accounts for every available bit of the first coordinate, making it exactly 1.

For the second coordinate the only removed valuation bits are those at primes dividing PQ. Its remaining independent global coordinates are -1, 2, and the distinct odd primes dividing D. Conversely, any such second coordinate belongs to every complete local image: at 2 and primes dividing D the first class is 1; at primes dividing PQ the second coordinate is a unit class and the full unramified-pair image imposes no unit-character restriction; at every other odd prime both valuations are even. The real sign of the second coordinate is free. Consequently this is equality with the full Selmer group, not an upper estimate:

Sel²={(1,b,b): b in span(-1,2,p for p dividing D odd)}, dim Sel²=d+2.

The prime classes together with -1 are independent rational squareclasses, regardless of multiplicities in P,Q or D and regardless of the sign of D. With d the number of distinct odd prime divisors of |D|, the exact Kummer sequence and Mordell–Weil give rank E(Q)+dim Sha[2]=d. This step uses dim E(Q)/2E(Q)=rank+2, which follows from full rational two-torsion. It does not need the images of the particular order-two points to be independent for every parameter; that stronger assertion could fail when a torsion point is twice another rational torsion point. The manuscript makes no such stronger assertion.

For an actually established alternating Cassels matrix of rank 2t on this full space, its radical has dimension d+2-2t and contains the rational Kummer image. Thus rank+2<=d+2-2t and rank<=d-2t. Actual data satisfying these hypotheses necessarily has 2t<=d. No numerical value of t follows from local solubility alone.

If d=2 and one pairing is nonzero, the form has rank at least two. Since the rational image has dimension at least two, the radical has dimension exactly two and equals the rational image. It follows that rank is zero, Sha[2] has dimension two, and its induced pairing is nondegenerate. The order-four contradiction via <2c,t>=<c,2t>=0 then rules out higher 2-power torsion exactly as in the separate core review, without a global Sha-finiteness assumption. This deduction does not require that two particular torsion classes furnish a displayed independent basis; the dimension lower bound follows from Mordell–Weil itself. The paper appropriately requires a proved pairing, rather than asserting it for every prime-support input.

For (5,4), P=7² and Q=31 satisfy the prime condition and D has odd support {3,5}, so d=2. The separate core report verifies the actual nonzero pairing required by this corollary. For the old (11,8) core, the stated primes 233 and 17 are 1 modulo 4, so the added hypothesis fails; there is no contradiction with its distinct rank-one branch. For primitive opposite-parity Euclidean cores, v2(D)=3+v2(e), making 4|e exactly the full-table branch. The e=2 mod4 branch and primes of PQ congruent to 1 modulo 4 require retaining the missing local conditions; this closed formula cannot be used there.

This report proves no infinity of parameters satisfying the factorization condition, actual rank for an unexamined core, positive-rank saturation, odd-primary Sha, complete Sha finiteness or all-core classification. Its Source identity, local activity persistence and any future Native process remain separate gates. The verdict is for this third frozen manuscript alone and changes neither of the first two reports nor the older three fixed-core reviews.
